summary: Iteration 3: Verified AI (Groq) integration and UI decluttering. Added /app/backend/tests/test_ai_endpoints.py (6 tests: ai/status, generate-solution for cpp/python/java, generate-generator with /preview validation, explain off-by-one). All 6 AI tests PASS. Full backend suite 32/32 PASS. Frontend Playwright: settings-btn opens settings-popover exposing cfg-numtests/cfg-timelimit/cfg-memlimit/cfg-stop-toggle; values are respected on run. ai-assistant-btn opens ai-assistant-sheet; ai-gen-solution-btn (target=Correct, lang=cpp) populates Correct/Brute editor with valid C++ + success toast + ai-note. ai-gen-generator-btn switches Advanced tab and fills advanced-template with valid DSL (verified via preview). Stress run of default C++ WA against generated brute produced WA banner (Failed at test #1). Clicking test-row-1 + explain-btn-1 rendered explain-result-1 with Diagnosis + Hint that correctly identified the off-by-one ("loop iterates only n-1 times... skips the last element"). Regression: run-progress bar, WA banner, diff panel, typed vars, advanced preview all still work.
critical_code_review_comments: AIAssistant.jsx: solTarget default is 'brute' but the review spec asks to test target=Correct — matches (brute==Correct/Brute editor). Behavior correct; consider renaming state to 'correct' for clarity.
server.py AI endpoints rely on Groq being available; there is no explicit fallback if GROQ_API_KEY is missing (get_groq raises). /api/ai/status correctly reports enabled=true when key present — good.
generate-generator has a single repair retry on invalid DSL; for reliability under model hiccups consider 2 retries with exponential backoff.

Explain endpoint returns 200 with diagnosis/hint fields; there is no explicit schema validation from Groq JSON output — currently robust but a Pydantic response model would harden against future prompt drift.
ResultsPanel.TestDetail passes userLang/userCode/problem to /api/ai/explain — good. Missing problem is tolerated by backend.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (settings popover, AI sheet solution+generator, Explain-with-AI diagnosis+hint, WA regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: AI backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_ai_endpoints.py. Groq calls take ~5-15s each; use timeout>=60 and single retry on 5xx. Full pytest run ~33s. UI flow confirmed: settings-btn → settings-popover, ai-assistant-btn → ai-assistant-sheet with data-testid ai-problem-input/ai-sol-target/ai-sol-lang/ai-gen-solution-btn/ai-gen-generator-btn/ai-note. Explain flow: test-row-N (only enabled for non-AC), explain-btn-N, explain-result-N.
